annotation.title_clean: Selecting appropriate artificial intelligence development strategy
annotation.title_en: Selecting appropriate artificial intelligence development strategy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Science and Technology (Vietnam), MST portal
annotation.venue: Ministry of Science and Technology (Vietnam) English portal
annotation.summary_en: August 2019 Vietnamese Ministry of Science and Technology news article on choosing an AI development strategy for Vietnam. It notes AI's role in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, global national AI strategies, and Vietnam's gaps in data, infrastructure and resources despite investment by Viettel, FPT and VNPT. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI is a pillar technology of the Fourth Industrial Revolution
Many countries are investing billions in national AI strategies
Vietnam lacks large databases, infrastructure and resources for AI
Domestic firms Viettel, FPT and VNPT are investing in AI
